Start from the question you want answered. Each row names the guide that shows
the SCGSim calls, then the complete notebook in the OrcaPen SC PDK, which owns
the component, its settings and its environment. The quickest start is
[First simulation](first-simulation.qmd): the capacitance of a pad with
Palace, in one script.

## Choose by your question {#getting-started}

| Your question | Guide | PDK notebook |
|---|---|---|
| What is the capacitance of a pad? | [Palace: terminal capacitance](../guides/capacitance-palace.qmd) · [AEDT: Q3D extraction](../guides/capacitance-q3d.qmd) | SimplePad: [Palace Electrostatic](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_electrostatic.qmd) · [AEDT Q3D](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.qmd) |
| What are the frequency and Q of a resonator, and how does its energy divide among surfaces, bulk and the junction? | [Palace: resonant modes](../guides/modes-palace.qmd) · [AEDT: HFSS Eigenmode](../guides/modes-hfss.qmd) | SimplePad: [Palace Eigenmode and EPR](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.qmd) · [HFSS Eigenmode and surface EPR](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.qmd) |
| What are the S-parameters of a two-port? | [AEDT: HFSS Driven Terminal](../guides/s-parameters-hfss.qmd) | [17-bridge CPW–meander coupon](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwMeanderAirbridge) (HFSS Driven Terminal) |
| What are the per-length C, G, L and R of a line? | [AEDT: Q2D cross-section extraction](../guides/line-parameters-q2d.qmd) | Finite-ground CPW: [AEDT Q2D](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_q2d.qmd) |

The notebooks are those of PDK revision `49e539f`, the revision the
[home page](../../index.qmd#install) installs; they were written for an earlier
SCGSim and are being moved to this version, so where a notebook and a guide
differ, follow the guide.

S-parameters need a layout with a lumped-port sheet for each of the two ports;
Driven Modal and wave ports are not available in this version.

## A larger worked example {#public-inputs}

The [flip-chip Xmon](../guides/xmon/inputs.qmd) example prepares one source for
both [Palace](../guides/xmon/palace.qmd) and [AEDT](../guides/xmon/aedt.qmd).
Its sources, and the other deeper examples, are in these PDK notebook groups
at the same revision:

| PDK notebook group | What it holds |
|---|---|
| [Kosen2024_Xmon](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon) | Palace Electrostatic and Eigenmode studies of the Xmon |
| [SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | HFSS Eigenmode, Q3D and Palace Eigenmode on the CPW coupon |
| [ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | The HFSS Driven Terminal source |
| [SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | Q2D rectangles and conductor groups |

The dimensions and presets in these notebooks are example inputs, not a
recommendation for your design.

## Before your own layout

Read the [supported scope](../reference/supported-scope.qmd) first: what the
layout must guarantee, what SCGSim guarantees in return, and who owns a
failure. The Guides then cover the steps around a calculation:
[preparing a layout](../guides/prepare-a-layout.qmd) and
[checking it](../guides/check-a-layout.qmd), [running on another
computer](../guides/run-elsewhere.qmd) and
[reading the results](../guides/convergence-and-reports.qmd).
